comments.content: The else branch now returns null instead of casting to CommandContextItemViewModel. This changes behavior for any IContextItem that isn't IContextItem or CommandContextItemViewModel - previously it would throw InvalidCastException, now it returns null. Is this intentional? If so, consider adding a comment explaining the expected item types.

The fallback now returns Default template instead of casting to CommandContextItemViewModel. This changes behavior for unknown item types - previously it would throw InvalidCastException, now it silently uses Default. Is this intentional? If so, consider logging a warning for unexpected types to aid debugging.
